instruments.purpose: protect hours with a real external deadline

misuse.reuse: relabel ordinary requests as urgent so they jump the queue
misuse.effect_on_purpose: urgent hours crowd out the requests the label was meant to protect
misuse.indicator: urgent requests without a deadline document attached
misuse.countermeasure: an urgency label counts only with the funder's deadline letter

misuse.reuse: push the share down by refusing urgent labels to show the metric improving
misuse.effect_on_purpose: real deadlines are missed while the indicator looks healthy
misuse.indicator: missed external deadlines on requests that were refused the urgent label
misuse.countermeasure: report missed deadlines beside the share every cycle

misuse.reuse: rank cycles by the urgent share and copy the settings of the best one
misuse.effect_on_purpose: the best-looking cycle was partly luck in how requests were labelled, so the copied settings protect nothing
misuse.indicator: deadline hits per cycle, compared across the cycles ranked best and worst by urgent share
misuse.countermeasure: judge settings over several cycles against deadline hits, never on one cycle's share

instruments.purpose: trigger a capacity decision before coordination stops helping

misuse.reuse: split one essential booking into several smaller ones to look less dominant
misuse.effect_on_purpose: the capacity trigger fires late because demand looks fragmented
misuse.indicator: bookings by one team within the same week whose sum exceeds its declared need
misuse.countermeasure: aggregate essential demand by project, not by booking

misuse.reuse: stop booking hours that will not be served once the laboratory is full
misuse.effect_on_purpose: near saturation recorded demand understates need, so the capacity trigger never fires
misuse.indicator: requests withdrawn or never filed that teams report in the cycle review
misuse.countermeasure: collect declared need per project each cycle, independent of bookings

instruments.statement: urgency labels require a deadline document
instruments.purpose: remove the incentive to inflate urgency

misuse.reuse: obtain generic deadline letters that cover every request
misuse.effect_on_purpose: the document becomes a formality and inflation resumes
misuse.indicator: deadline letters reused across unrelated projects
misuse.countermeasure: letters name the project and the date; the coordinator samples them each cycle
